reddit.title: Explore the New Campaign in Provincia: Five Territories Beyond the Basin
reddit.body: We're excited to share a sneak peek of our new campaign feature in Provincia! In Tutorial 2 · Conquest, players will navigate a locked home valley and conquer five adjacent territories. Each territory offers unique rewards and challenges, with fog covering unexplored areas until you march. Check out the details and get ready to expand your colony! Read more here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin

steam.title: Discover the New Conquest Campaign in Provincia!
steam.body: We're excited to introduce a new gameplay mode in Provincia: Tutorial 2 · Conquest! Players will start in a locked home valley and can conquer five territories, each providing unique rewards. Navigate through fog-covered areas and strategize your attacks to expand your colony. Learn more about this exciting update and how to get started: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin
